data_objects.name: tenant_product_scores
data_objects.meaning: Timestamped score events identified by tenant and score-product name.

variables.name: gmt_occur
variables.meaning: Event timestamp formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS; the timezone is not stated.

variables.name: tenant
variables.meaning: Categorical tenant identifier encoded as TENANT_ followed by a zero-padded number.

variables.name: product_name
variables.meaning: Chinese-language name of the score product or product version that produced the observation.

variables.name: score
variables.meaning: Numeric product output; values span more than one apparent scale and may include -1 as a special value.

structure.description: Each row is a timestamped tenant-product score event. product_name is essential context because score scales are not uniform across products.

uncertainties: The timezone, score calibration, and interpretation of the -1 value are not documented.
No separate event identifier is present, so row uniqueness may depend on multiple columns.
annotation_notes: Do not pool score values across product_name categories without accounting for their potentially different scales.
